subject: jacob-marley

subject: boyhood-boarding-school

subject: fan

subject: belle

quote: I do; and I release you. With a full heart, for the love of him you once were.

subject: ghost-of-christmas-present

subject: ghost-of-christmas-present

quote: taking off the covers as their bearers passed, sprinkled incense on their dinners from his torch

subject: ghost-of-christmas-present

quote: notwithstanding his gigantic size, he could accommodate himself to any place with ease

subject: martha-cratchit

subject: bob-cratchit

subject: desolate-moor

subject: ebenezer-scrooge

subject: ebenezer-scrooge

subject: ebenezer-scrooge
statement: Scrooge has been revolving in his mind a change of life, and has new-born resolutions.

subject: mrs-dilber

subject: ebenezer-scrooge
